note: A heating curve and ice's heat of fusion (GAME_SPEC §8, §13.7, Stage 71; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 26): a 250 mL beaker of 100 g of crushed ice from the freezer at -10 C and the lab's burner; a foam cup of 100 g of water at 40 C and a jar of 20 g of ice at 0 C, in two cubes. Heated and stirred, the ice warms to 0 C, holds there while it melts, the water warms to 100 C and holds there while it boils: the plateaus. The cubes into the warm water: what its fall in temperature gives up melts them and warms their water, the heat of fusion (IAPWS: 6.01 kJ/mol, 334 J/g).
